(Case 05)2026

DriveStorage

“Try for Free” landing page and explainer video storyboard

Drive Storage rents self-storage units in Poland. Renting storage unseen feels risky, and a visit with a salesperson feels like pressure. The “Try for Free” offer lets anyone book a free, self-guided visit to see a unit before renting. I designed the landing page that sells this offer and the explainer video that shows how it works.

Role
UI/UX Designer — landing & motion
Deliverables
Landing page · explainer storyboard
Platforms
Desktop · Mobile
Languages
English · Polish

0 PLN

Cost of the visit

11

Scenes in the explainer

2

Languages: EN & PL

Task

Renting storage unseen feels risky, and a visit with a salesperson feels like pressure. The “Try for Free” offer needed a page that makes a free, self-guided visit an easy yes.

Solution

The landing page answers the four questions people ask before booking: no salesperson, no card, any time, access by phone. Real product screens instead of illustrations, and an explainer video that tells the same story — book online, visit in person.

Result

A 0 PLN, no-card visit flow in English and Polish, plus an 11-scene, ~40-second explainer storyboard for ads and social.
